title: UPSC CSE - Indian Geography - Indian Map
subject: Indian Geography

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
Wetland/Lake Location
1. Hokera Wetland Punjab
2. Renuka Wetland Himachal Pradesh
3. Rudrasagar Lake Tripura
4. Sasthamkotta Lake Tamil Nadu
How many pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.explain:
Only 2 pairs are correctly matched:
1. Hokera Wetland: Jammu and Kashmir
2. Renuka Wetland: Himachal Pradesh
3. Rudrasagar Lake: Tripura
4. Sasthamkotta Lake: Kerala
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q: With reference to India, Didwana, Kuchaman, Sargol and Khatu are the names of
questions.explain: Didwana, Kuchaman, Sargol and Khatu are the names of some of the important saltwater lakes in India. A salt lake or saline lake is a landlocked body of water that has a concentration of salts (typically sodium chloride) and other dissolved minerals significantly higher than most lakes (often defined as at least three grams of salt per litre).
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q: What is common to the places known as Aliyar, Isapur and Kangsabati?
questions.explain: Aliyar, Isapur and Kangsabati are related to water reservoirs. The Kangsabati Reservoir Project is in West Bengal, Aliyar Reservoir is in Tamil Nadu, and Isapur reservoir is in Maharashtra.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Barren Island volcano is an active volcano located in Indian territory.
2. Barren Island lies about 140 km east of Great Nicobar.
3. The last time the Barren Island volcano erupted was in 1991 and it has remained inactive since then.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is correct: Barren Island is an active volcano in the Andaman Islands.\nStatement 2 is incorrect: Barren Island lies about 140 km from Port Blair, not Great Nicobar.\nStatement 3 is incorrect: The last recorded eruption of Barren Island volcano was in 2018, not 1991.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q: Which one of the following is an artificial lake?
questions.explain: Kodaikanal Lake in Tamil Nadu is one of the finest man-made (artificial) lakes in India. Kolleru lake in Andhra Pradesh is a natural freshwater lake. Naini Lake in Uttarakhand is a natural lake. Renuka lake in Himachal Pradesh is also a natural lake.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q: Among the following cities, which one lies on a longitude closest to that of Delhi?
questions.explain: The longitude of Delhi is 77.1025° E. Bengaluru with longitude 77.5946° E lies on the longitude closest to that of Delhi. Hyderabad: 78.4867° E, Nagpur: 79.0882° E, Pune: 73.8567° E
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q: If you travel by road from Kohima to Kottayam, what is the minimum number of States within India through which you can travel, including the origin and the destination?
questions.explain: The shortest route from Kohima to Kottayam will pass through the minimum seven states: Nagaland-Assam-West Bengal-Odisha-Andhra Pradesh-Tamil Nadu-Kerala.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q: At one of the places in India, if you stand on the seashore and watch the sea, you will find that the seawater recedes from the shoreline a few kilometres and comes back to the shore, twice a day, and you can actually walk on the seafloor when the water recedes. This unique phenomenon is seen at
questions.explain: The Chandipur beach in the Balasore district of Odisha experiences this unique phenomenon. During low tides, the beach recedes up to 5 KM, allowing visitors to walk on the seabed. This occurs twice a day due to the ebb and flow of tides.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
Place of Pilgrimage Location
1. Srisailam Nallamala Hills
2. Omkareshwar Satmala Hills
3. Pushkar Mahadeo Hills
Which of the above pairs is/are correctly matched?
questions.explain: Pair 1 is correct: Srisailam is located in the Nallamala Hills in Andhra Pradesh.\nPair 2 is incorrect: Omkareshwar is located on an island in the Narmada River, not in Satmala Hills.\nPair 3 is incorrect: Pushkar is located in the Aravalli Range in Rajasthan, not in Mahadeo Hills.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Dampa Tiger Reserve : Mizoram
2. Gumti Wildlife Sanctuary : Sikkim
3. Saramati Peak : Nagaland
Which of the above pairs is/are correctly matched?
questions.explain: Pair 1 is correct: The Dampa Tiger Reserve is the largest wildlife sanctuary in Mizoram.\nPair 2 is incorrect: The Gumti Wildlife Sanctuary is located in Tripura, not Sikkim.\nPair 3 is correct: Saramati is the highest peak (3841m) in Nagaland, located on the Nagaland-Myanmar border.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
National Highway Cities connected
1. NH 4 Chennai and Hyderabad
2. NH 6 Mumbai and Kolkata
3. NH 15 Ahmedabad and Jodhpur
Which of the above pairs is/are correctly matched?
questions.explain: None of the pairs are correctly matched. NH 4 connects Mumbai and Chennai via Bangalore. NH 6 connects Kolkata and Surat via Raipur. NH 15 connects Samakhiali (Gujarat) to Pathankot (Punjab) via Rajasthan (Jodhpur).
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
National Park River flowing through the park
1. Corbett National Park : Ganga
2. Kaziranga National Park : Manas
3. Silent Valley National Park : Kaveri
Which of the above pairs is/are correctly matched?
questions.explain: None of the pairs are correctly matched. Corbett National Park: Ramganga River. Kaziranga National Park: Brahmaputra River. Silent Valley National Park: Kunthipuzha River.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
1. Nokrek Biosphere Reserve : Garo Hills
2. Logtak (Loktak) Lake : Barail Range
3. Namdapha National Park : Dafla Hills
Which of the above pairs is/are correctly matched?
questions.explain: Pair 1 is correct: Nokrek Biosphere Reserve is located in the Garo Hills of Meghalaya.\nPair 2 is incorrect: Loktak Lake is in Manipur, not in the Barail Range.\nPair 3 is incorrect: Namdapha National Park is in Arunachal Pradesh, not in the Dafla Hills.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
Tribe State
1. Limboo (Limbu) : Sikkim
2. Karbi : Himachal Pradesh
3. Dongaria Kondh : Odisha
4. Bonda : Tamil Nadu
Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.explain:
Pair 1 is correct: Limboo tribe is found in Sikkim.
Pair 2 is incorrect: Karbi tribe is found in Assam, not Himachal Pradesh.
Pair 3 is correct: Dongaria Kondh tribe is found in Odisha.
Pair 4 is incorrect: Bonda tribe is found in Odisha, not Tamil Nadu.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q:
A particular State in India has the following characteristics:
1. It is located on the same latitude which passes through northern Rajasthan.
2. It has over 80% of its area under forest cover.
3. Over 12% of forest cover constitutes the Protected Area Network in this State.
Which one among the following States has all the above characteristics?
questions.explain:
Arunachal Pradesh fits all the characteristics:
1. It lies between 26° 28'N - 29° 30'N, which passes through northern Rajasthan.
2. It has over 80% forest cover (80.50% as per India State of Forest Report 2011).
3. It has a large network of protected areas covering 18.48% of recorded forest area.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q:
With reference to 'Changpa' community of India, consider the following statements:
1. They live mainly in the State of Uttarakhand.
2. They rear the Pashmina goats that yield fine wool.
3. They are kept in the category of Scheduled Tribes.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is incorrect: The Changpa live in Ladakh, not Uttarakhand.\nStatement 2 is correct: They rear Pashmina goats that yield fine wool.\nStatement 3 is correct: They are categorized as a Scheduled Tribe.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q: Which one of the following pairs of islands is separated from each other by the 'Ten Degree Channel'?
questions.explain: The Ten Degree Channel separates the Andaman Islands from the Nicobar Islands. It is a channel in the southeastern part of the Bay of Bengal. It is approximately 150 km wide and lies on the 10-degree line of latitude, north of the equator.
questions.subject: Indian Geography

questions.q:
Consider the following towns of India:
1. Bhadrachalam
2. Chanderi
3. Kancheepuram
4. Karnal
Which of the above are famous for the production of traditional sarees/fabric?
questions.explain:
Chanderi in Madhya Pradesh is famous for its hand-woven sarees.
Kancheepuram in Tamil Nadu is renowned for its hand-woven silk sarees.
Bhadrachalam is famous for its Lord Ram temple, not for sarees.
Karnal is known for its shoe industry, not for traditional textiles.
questions.subject: Indian Geography
